knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Restricting access and avoiding dust-raising actions comes before any handling.
The record states the observation and the referral. It does not name a pest or claim a result.
Vacuuming can spread particles. The request is recorded and referred, not carried out.

practicalCriteria: In a photographed or drawn scene, the learner records two indicators as observations and restricts the access route on paper.
The learner writes the referral with no pest name or result in the record.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Droppings, mouldy goods or unknown liquids are disturbed or dry swept.
A sealed container is opened to identify its contents.
